subject: Renewal + mid-cycle add-on: proposal for flexible lane add-on and blended discount
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@paxionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + mid-cycle add-on: proposal for flexible lane add-on and blended discount

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Based on what you described (seasonal peaks for batch inference and a steady baseline), we put together a short set of options to add a "Flex Lane" add-on to your existing plan that gives you burst capacity without fully committing additional GPUs. This would sit alongside your current renewal and be billed as an amendment (prorated to your renewal date).

Two high-level options for discussion:

- Option A — Blended commit: add a 20% annual capacity uplift on a 12-month addendum. In return Paxion receives a blended 14% discount on the uplift consumption. This gives predictable unit economics and priority routing for burst traffic.
- Option B — Flex-as-you-go: a smaller committed baseline + usage tiers. Lower upfront commit, 8% discount on committed units, then volume tier discounted rates for overages.

Ask: can you confirm the expected peak Q3 token volume range and whether the bursts are regular (weekly) versus ad-hoc? Those numbers let us pick the right commit size and model for the blended discount. Also please confirm whether procurement prefers a mid-cycle amendment or for us to annualize the uplift at renewal.

I can put a pro-forma together for finance once I have your rough peak estimates. If useful I can also schedule a 20-min call with Ben (sales lead) and Lauren (billing) to walk through proration and invoicing.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: none in this message

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@paxionhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-cycle add-on: proposal for flexible lane add-on and blended discount

Jordan —

Appreciate the options. Quick answers:
- Peaks are concentrated in Q3 and Q4, roughly 3x baseline for a 6–8 week window; some weeks are heavier than others (ad-hoc clinical validation runs).
- Procurement prefers a single amendment if possible rather than rejiggering the full renewal.
- Finance will need a pro-forma invoice and an explanation of proration to justify the spend; our budget window closes mid-June.

Can you share a ballpark dollar amount for Option A vs Option B so I can assess internally? Also, we need to ensure any SLA or data residency commitments remain unchanged — SOC 2 evidence is typically requested when we increase spend.

Thanks — I cc'd procurement for visibility (procurement@paxionhealth.com).

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Head of ML Ops
Paxion Health

Attachment requested: proforma-paxion-flexlane-v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@paxionhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-cycle add-on: proposal for flexible lane add-on and blended discount

Thanks Maria — added some quick pricing sketches below so you have something to run to finance. Numbers are intentionally conservative until we see detailed token estimates. All amounts are illustrative and before tax.

Option A — Blended commit (recommended if Paxion wants predictable billing):
- Add 20% of current committed capacity for 12 months.
- Blended uplift price: $0.085 / 1k tokens (effective after discount).
- Estimated incremental annual cost: $220,000 (prorated for the remainder of the term if we do mid-cycle amendment).
- Priority routing and soft SLA bump for the add-on.

Option B — Flex-as-you-go (lower commit):
- Commit 8% baseline + usage tiers for bursts.
- Committed price: $0.095 / 1k tokens; overage tiers: $0.09 / 1k tokens for 1–3M tokens, $0.08 / 1k tokens beyond that.
- Estimated incremental annual cost range: $110k–$260k depending on burst volume.

Proration note: If we do a mid-cycle amendment (e.g., add on 6/15), we will prorate the add-on for the remainder of your 12-month term and invoice on the next monthly billing cycle. For finance, we can provide a one-line pro-forma for each option.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/px-2027-0431 (internal)

If Maria can give a 6–8 week peak token estimate (total tokens per week), we can tighten the numbers and produce a one-page pro-forma. I'm happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through calculations.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proforma-paxion-flexlane-v1.pdf (placeholder — will attach once Jordan confirms the option)

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@paxionhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>, procurement@paxionhealth.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-cycle add-on: proposal for flexible lane add-on and blended discount

Ben/Jordan —

Thanks for the sketches. A few clarifying items from procurement and security:
- SLA: can you confirm the impact on latency SLOs for burst traffic? Our clinical runs are latency-sensitive.
- Security: procurement requires current SOC 2 report and a short note on data residency for the add-on — we need to confirm data stays in our configured region.
- Ramp credits: because some of the Q3 runs are exploratory, is there any ramp credit you can provide if actual usage is below the committed uplift in the first quarter? That helps finance greenlight the amendment.

We aim to decide by June 10; getting a pro-forma and SOC 2 evidence before then would be ideal.

—Maria

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@paxionhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-cycle add-on: proposal for flexible lane add-on and blended discount

Hi Maria — looping in billing ops. A few operational notes that should help procurement:

- Invoice/proration: We will generate a single amendment invoice for the add-on pro-rated to your anniversary date; monthly billing will reflect the proration on the first invoice after the amendment posts. If you prefer a single up-front charge we can quote that as well.
- Ramp credits: we can include a one-time ramp credit equal to 10% of the uplift value applied within the first 90 days if actual usage is below 70% of the committed uplift. This is standard in the market and helps mitigate your risk.
- SOC 2: I'll attach the SOC 2 certificate and a short data residency addendum.

Attaching draft SOW for the Flex Lane add-on: sow-flexlane-draft.docx (please treat as draft). If the team confirms Option A, we can prepare an amendment to the MSA and a DocuSign packet (link below).

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/px-flexlane-amendment

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sow-flexlane-draft.docx; SOC2-summary.pdf (will attach in final packet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodai.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-cycle add-on: proposal for flexible lane add-on and blended discount

Maria / Paxion procurement —

Thanks for the clear timeline. Next steps from our side:
1) I will send a one-page pro-forma for Option A and Option B by end of day Friday (6/4) with proration examples and a one-line summary for finance.
2) Lauren will attach the SOC 2 summary and the draft SOW; Ben will update the HubSpot deal with the selected option and high-level economics.
3) If Paxion is comfortable with Option A, we will draft a mid-cycle amendment to the MSA and route via DocuSign for signature with monthly invoicing and the 10% ramp credit clause.

Please let me know if you prefer the amendment to be invoiced up-front or prorated across monthly invoices — I can include both numbers in the pro-forma. If we could get a tentative option selection by June 10, that keeps us inside your budget window.

Onward —
Jordan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
